On Sat, 28 Nov 2026 at 12:03 PM Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com> wrote:

Hi Marta — thanks for the note and the docs.

Short answers up front: Redwood supports Net 30 / Net 45 / Net 60. Our standard pay run cutoff for vendor invoices is the 20th of each month for payment on the next cycle (so invoices received by the 20th hit the following month). For faster cash, we can pilot an advance (prefund) for newly onboarded suppliers under a one-time agreement. Typical pilot parameters we offer:

- Prefund up to 50% of invoice value at day 15 after invoice receipt
- Fee structure typically 1.5–2.5% of advanced amount (negotiable depending on volume)
- PO must be issued and invoice must match PO number and SOW line items

To get started I need: the completed Redwood vendor onboarding form, confirmation of ACH details, and signed authorization for the one-time advance pilot (DocuSign is fine). I've attached the vendor onboarding form (redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf).

Can you confirm if Net 45 is your preference and whether Orchard can accept a 1.9% advance fee for a pilot on the first two invoices? If yes, we'll run it as an exception with Finance (cc'ed).

Thanks — I can also hop on a 20–25 minute call early next week if that helps.
